purpose: Implementation decision manifest; not a dependency lockfile or executable deployment configuration

assumptions.architecture: modular Go monolith with separate worker and isolated browser capture process
assumptions.email_login: verified email and password through Keycloak
assumptions.tag_ownership: note owner; own labels on others notes require saved_items later

version_policy.exact_versions: Resolve compatible supported patch versions in P0; commit go.sum and pnpm-lock.yaml; pin container and model digests
version_policy.browser: Playwright package and browser image must match

backend.validation: Huma input schema + explicit service invariants
backend.api_contract: Go DTOs -> OpenAPI 3.1 -> generated TypeScript types
backend.raw_queries: database/sql with PostgreSQL placeholders; same sql.Tx as Bun changes
backend.migration_style: versioned reviewed SQL; no production AutoMigrate
backend.transactional_enqueue: InsertTx with bun.Tx.Tx in application write transaction

auth.flow: Authorization Code + PKCE + state + nonce; Go BFF
auth.session_store: PostgreSQL; token hashes, expiry and revocation
auth.browser_credentials: Secure HttpOnly host-only session cookie; CSRF protection
auth.authorization_source: application PostgreSQL; not identity provider roles
auth.smtp: external in production; Mailpit development profile

frontend.editor_storage: versioned Tiptap JSON + derived plain text

storage.exact_search: PostgreSQL EXISTS / NOT EXISTS; ALL / ANY / NONE
storage.text_search: PostgreSQL tsvector/GIN; pg_trgm for autocomplete if needed
storage.blob_store_initial: local persistent volume, immutable SHA-256 CAS
storage.path_model: immutable snapshot manifest maps origin/path/query/request variant to blob
storage.filesystem_export: hardlinks on same Linux filesystem; encoded collision paths
storage.blob_store_later: S3 via AWS SDK for Go v2; Garage candidate subject to compatibility tests

capture.mode_initial: bounded rendered DOM static snapshot; original resources preserved; scripts disabled on view
capture.protocol: versioned private authenticated HTTP; streamed bounded bundle; Go worker owns River and persistent storage
capture.interactive_replay_candidate: Browsertrix Crawler + ReplayWeb.page; gated by P0.2
capture.browser_network: egress-enforced public Internet only; no DB, application, metadata or host access
capture.viewer: separate origin/domain + sandbox + restrictive CSP + current ACL per resource

semantic_index.model_status: provisional until RU/EN corpus evaluation and resource measurements
semantic_index.collection_policy: one per embedding space; model changes create new collection
semantic_index.point_id: deterministic UUID for document version, chunk and embedding generation
semantic_index.authorization: prefilter -> candidate IDs/scores -> current PostgreSQL ACL/version/tags -> text -> user or LLM

monorepo.javascript_workspaces: independent pnpm workspaces in backend and frontend; no cross-workspace dependencies

deployment.additional_required_boundary: restricted capture browser egress via proxy/firewall; Compose networks alone are insufficient

verification.contract: OpenAPI export and generated client drift check

unresolved_gates: P0 archive fidelity and interactive replay scope
